quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert argues LeBron James will not win a championship in Miami
quotes.excerpt: I just know you ain't winning shit in Miami. Y'all need three years.
quotes.quote: If that's the top destination, I just know you ain't winning shit in Miami. Y'all need three years. If this is about ending your career the way it should go, go to Cleveland. Just don't go to Cleveland trying to be happy about a win, because you're not going to win there.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert breaks down the motivations behind LeBron James's potential free agency move
quotes.excerpt: If this is about a ring, Philly. This is about selling tickets, Miami.
quotes.quote: If this is about a ring, Philly. This is about selling tickets, Miami. If this is about ending your career the way it should go, go to Cleveland. Just don't go to Cleveland trying to be happy about a win, because you're not going to win there. You're going to be an unhappy camper in the playoffs, kid.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert explains why he would choose Philadelphia or Golden State for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: The only thing that means anything to me is LeBron getting six rings to match Jordan.
quotes.quote: If I'm LeBron in this moment, I want to win. I know that the retirement tour means so much to everybody else. The only thing that means anything to me is LeBron getting six rings to match Jordan. The only way I see that route going is Philly or Golden State. I don't know why Stephen Curry always proves me wrong of having more in the tank, but I'm done betting against the light-skinned dude with the eyes. So if he go over there, I would expect to see great basketball and I would expect to see a slugfest in the playoffs to where Father Time has to beat the youth. On the other hand, I could see in Philly, he would be the great glue guy that they always needed and he would give another franchise that has been longing for a championship a chance to go and get a title. Tyrese Maxey has been all the legs LeBron needs. Vite Edjko got all the legs LeBron needs to just do his thing and they'll run rapid around anybody.
